records.name: Fleeep
records.tagline: The notes app for people who make things.
records.description: Fleeep is one calm place for everything that inspires you Most of us keep ideas in five places at once: screenshots, a notes app, saved posts, bookmarks and open tabs. Fleeep puts them in one place that works on your phone and your computer, online or off.

records.name: Deal Pilot
records.tagline: AI SDR that books meetings in Japan, the US & SE Asia
records.description: Deal Pilot finds and verifies decision-makers by country and role, writes personalized cold email in English, Japanese or Chinese, and follows up until there's a meeting. 6.0% reply rate across 644 A/B-tested emails.

records.name: Switchy
records.tagline: Mac controls, deploys, 2FA & AI limits in your menu bar
records.description: Mac switches, deploy status, local servers, 2FA codes and Claude/Codex limits in one native menu bar panel. Apple silicon, macOS 14+. Free for 7 days without an account or card, then $4.99 once for up to 3 Macs.

records.name: Trace by Context.dev
records.tagline: Weekly web scraping API benchmark
records.description: Compare web scraping APIs on a fresh sample every Friday. Explore page access, latency percentiles, document quality, cost per page, and failure reasons, with confidence intervals and page-level data.

records.name: Rex (Beta)
records.tagline: Building the multiplexer for all work
records.description: Hello, world. We've been building a terminal multiplexer and we think you're going to love it. Native apps (e.g., macOS/iOS), accessible from the web, multiplayer. From the creators of Ghostty and Echo.

records.name: Sendoff
records.tagline: Say "send it." to automatically email your list
records.description: Sendoff emails your list (newsletters, launches, announcements) from Claude or Codex, self-hosted on your own Cloudflare and AWS accounts and sending through Amazon SES.

records.name: kayet
records.tagline: the minimalistic text editor for macOS
records.description: A quiet, distraction-free text editor for macOS.

records.name: GPT‑6 Cyber
records.tagline: OpenAI’s cyber model, with vetted access for defenders
records.description: GPT-6 Cyber is OpenAI’s cybersecurity model, which per OpenAI pairs stronger security research with better alignment. It powered OpenAI’s Linux kernel research. Rated Critical in cybersecurity, it starts with a small group of vetted Daybreak Red customers, with identity checks, MFA and an application required. OpenAI says broader access is expected over the coming weeks. No public pricing yet.

records.name: LiveReview
records.tagline: Free, Risk-Aware Code Review: Auto Approve Low-Risk Changes
records.description: Most AI review tools flag issues. LiveReview promises production results: fewer incidents, fewer rollbacks, less senior reviewer load. Every PR is risk-scored. The lowest-risk 30-50% are safely auto-approved; the risky ones go straight to the engineers who should see them. The approach is inspired by Meta's highly successful internal AI review system, where production incidents fell 50x and rollbacks 3x. LLM + incident-trained ML + code-graph analysis. Free and self-hostable.

records.name: Instagram Edits for Desktop
records.tagline: Instagram's free desktop video editor with AI agents
records.description: Instagram Edits is now on Mac, bringing professional video editing and AI agents together. Connect compatible AI assistants through MCP to assemble rough cuts and make edits, then take over with a multi-track timeline, keyframes, color grading, and precise audio controls. Export watermark-free videos in 4K, use Instagram's music library, and publish directly to Instagram. Free to use, with no subscription required for the core editor.

records.name: Duly
records.tagline: Press the orb, ramble, and everything gets organized
records.description: Press the orb and ramble. Duly turns it into reminders, lists, ideas and notes. Say "call mom at 6, buy milk" and you get a reminder and a grocery item. Change anything the same way. Free to use every day, on iPhone and iPad.

records.name: Dino Kids
records.tagline: Free, ad-free learning app for kids 3+ in five languages
records.description: A learning app for children from age 3: coloring, letter tracing, phonics, math, piano and 500 folk tales — in Vietnamese, Japanese, English, Korean and Chinese. Free, no ads, no in-app purchases, no account required, works offline once content is downloaded.

records.name: PacerTrip
records.tagline: Pick a marathon abroad. We plan the trip around race day.
records.description: Planning a marathon abroad means race dates, entry windows and fees on different sites, often not in your language. PacerTrip puts it in one app: 3,000+ races in 142 countries with entry dates and fees in your currency, a reminder the day before entry opens (big races can sell out on day one), stays sorted by distance to the start, an AI race-week itinerary, and a runner community for every race, auto-translated into your language. Free on iOS, Android and the web, in 44 languages.

records.name: Quest
records.tagline: Your personal AI advisor for a more intentional life
records.description: Most AI assistants help you get things done. Quest takes the time to understand your personality, values, ambitions, and motivations. More than just remembering conversations, it's a personal AI advisor that helps you reflect, navigate difficult choices, and make decisions aligned with who you are. Not another assistant telling you what to do, but a thoughtful advisor helping you find your own path.

records.name: ClarifierAI for Chrome
records.tagline: Use AI for writing & translating in your Chrome
records.description: Now on Chrome: ClarifierAI rewrites, fixes and translates only the text you select, in any text field. Improve, Polite, Shorten, Grammar and 119 languages, right where you type ⚡️

records.name: Standflow
records.tagline: Sit, stand, perch, and move on a rhythm from your menu bar
records.description: Standflow is a standing desk timer that lives in your Mac's menu bar. It guides you through a cycle of sitting, standing, perching on a tall stool, and short movement breaks, so you change posture often instead of sitting (or standing) all day. Start from a preset like Easy Start, based on the 20-8-2 guideline, or drag the cycle ring to build your own. Reminders can move on automatically or ask first. Track a daily standing goal and 7/30/90-day metrics. No account: your data stays on your Mac.

records.name: seam
records.tagline: Turn your Mac's notch into a Dynamic Island
records.description: Seam turns the notch into a Dynamic Island. Dictate into any app, control music, see when Claude Code finishes and run a focus timer. Voice runs on your Mac. $19.90 once for 2 Macs, with a 48-hour free trial and no card.

records.name: Muse Realtime Avatar
records.tagline: Turn voice chats with Muse into live video calls
records.description: Muse Realtime Avatar gives Meta's Muse agent a face you can video chat with. Voice and video come from one speech stream, so lips, expressions, gestures and posture move with every word, and the reply starts in about 870 ms. Unlike talking-head avatars that only animate a face, it moves hands and full body too, and the character stays consistent from turn to turn. In Meta's live-call tests, raters preferred it 78% of the time over Runway Characters and 88% over HeyGen LiveAvatar.

records.name: Google Omni 1.2 Flash
records.tagline: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: 15s AI video at $0.07 per second
records.description: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is Google DeepMind’s video generation and editing model, now generally available. Per Google, clips run up to 15 seconds, up from 10, and 720p costs $0.07 per second, 30% less than Omni 1.1. New: multi-turn editing without regenerating, steadier characters and styles, clearer lip-sync and smoother camera moves. Draft at 360p or 720p, then upscale to 1080p or 4K. In the Gemini API, Google Cloud, Flow and Vids.

records.name: ChatGPT Images 2.6
records.tagline: Create, edit, and animate images with AI
records.description: Images 2.6 brings faster image generation, more precise editing, and native GIF creation to ChatGPT, Codex, and the API. Create looping animations, maintain character and product consistency across edits, export SVGs, and control generation complexity.

records.name: Exa Monitors v2
records.tagline: Web search on a schedule that calls your agent, $2/1k runs
records.description: Exa Monitors v2 is web search on a schedule for AI agents. Describe what to watch, pick an interval, and Exa calls your webhook only when something new and relevant turns up, with a summary or JSON output and citations. Per Exa, v2 remembers what it has already sent, is quieter than v1, and costs $2 per 1k runs, down from $15. Watch prices, news, competitors, people and more. Python SDK and API available.

records.name: The Writer's Quarter
records.tagline: AI-Free Writing & Novel Planning Software
records.description: Write your manuscript, build your characters and keep every part of your story connected in one calm, visual, AI-free workspace.

records.name: Capnot
records.tagline: Make Screen Demos Clear, Even on Mute
records.description: Capnot puts captions, annotations and pointer tools on top of any app on your Mac, so a screen demo still makes sense with the sound off. Type a subtitle, or a speech bubble that follows your cursor, or just talk and it captions you live. Draw arrows, boxes and numbered steps, blur anything secret, then spotlight or magnify the part that matters. Every tool is one hotkey away and works with any screen recorder or screen share. No editing afterwards, no subscription.

records.name: Sequence Tool
records.tagline: Edit with words: long recordings into polished stories
records.description: Sequence Tool is a native Mac app that turns long recordings into stories. Edit from text, prepare multiple angles, and export. It offers on-device transcription with optional CLI and MCP, designed to speed first-pass editing and surface key moments faster. Create what Matters.

records.name: Critix
records.tagline: Next Gen Movie Reviews
records.description: Discover, rate, and curate your cinematic journey with Critix.

records.name: Fridgy
records.tagline: Shopping
records.description: One shared, real-time shopping list for the whole family — living in a very friendly fridge.

records.name: Fleeep
records.tagline: The notes app for people who make things.
records.description: Fleeep is one calm place for everything that inspires you Most of us keep ideas in five places at once: screenshots, a notes app, saved posts, bookmarks and open tabs. Fleeep puts them in one place that works on your phone and your computer, online or off.

records.name: Deal Pilot
records.tagline: AI SDR that books meetings in Japan, the US & SE Asia
records.description: Deal Pilot finds and verifies decision-makers by country and role, writes personalized cold email in English, Japanese or Chinese, and follows up until there's a meeting. 6.0% reply rate across 644 A/B-tested emails.

records.name: NEET Exam Prep AI: Mock & MCQ
records.tagline: Offline NEET UG MCQs, PYQs, notes & mock tests (EN/தமிழ்)
records.description: NEET Exam Prep AI is a complete offline study companion for NEET (UG) aspirants preparing for MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BSMS, BUMS, and medical entrance examinations. Revise Class 11 and Class 12 NCERT-aligned Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology notes, practice chapter-wise MCQs with step-by-step explanations, and take full-length NEET-pattern timed mock tests offline—available in English, தமிழ் (Tamil), हिन्दी (Hindi), and 10 more Indian languages (13 languages total).

records.name: Code On WoW (CoW)
records.tagline: Chat with Claude Code and Codex inside World of Warcraft
records.description: Code while you play. CoW lets you ask Claude Code or Codex about your project from a popup inside World of Warcraft, then keep playing: you get an alert when the agent replies. A free desktop app (Windows and macOS) runs the agent on your PC, only in folders you allow, and read-only unless you turn on edits. Up to 16 chats, each with its own folder, agent and history. The agent also knows your quests and position, and can drop map markers or start a leveling guide.

records.name: FebHop
records.tagline: Move windows across displays and recall them by keyboard
records.description: FebHop from FEB lets you send windows to another display, recall them to your main screen, and launch apps, websites, files or commands with shortcuts. All features are free with occasional ads; Pro removes ads. The Mac App Store build requires macOS 14+ and uses Apple Shortcuts for window actions, so some moves may be delayed.

records.name: CalculatesAll
records.tagline: Free Online Calculators and Utility Tools
records.description: Free online calculators for adult maintenance calories, EMI, Zakat, BMI, profit and loss, discounts, age and unit conversion, with clear formulas.

records.name: Tabletop Coach
records.tagline: Get coached on every backgammon move
records.description: Play backgammon, cribbage and Four in a Row against the computer, with a coach that reviews every move. Play against friends too. Or try the Daily Position. Pro features include practice based on your previous mistakes. Play for free on your browser. Games get saved and you don't even need an account. You only need an account to play against friends and carry your progress anywhere.

records.name: Reckona
records.tagline: Daily Takes. Weekly Insights.
records.description: Seven days. Seven takes. They reveal more than you think. Discover the patterns and connections shaping you each week. Reckona gives you one short statement a day. Agree or disagree - that's it. Over your personal 7-day week, your takes start to form a pattern. At the end of the week, Reckona connects your answers and turns them into a personal insight about how you think - including connections you may not have noticed yourself.

records.name: Agentmatica
records.tagline: Turn the questions shoppers ask into orders
records.description: Agentmatica is the sales and support agent for online stores. Paste your URL and it learns your pages and catalog. When a shopper asks which one to get, it answers from your content, shows the products as cards and suggests what goes with them. On Shopify and WooCommerce it builds the cart and hands over a checkout link. It handles shipping, returns and order questions too, and you can coach it privately, take over any chat and hand it back.

records.name: Kady.AI
records.tagline: Kady — Your personal AI that gets things done
records.description: Meet Kady, your personal AI assistant designed to go beyond conversations. Talk or type naturally, share files, manage tasks and commitments, and let Kady help you take action. From keeping track of your agenda to sending email reminders, Kady helps you stay organized without having to remember everything yourself. Less managing. More living. Website: getkady.com

records.name: Scientific Converters
records.tagline: Unit Converters for Science & Engineering
records.description: Precise unit conversions for science & engineering. Exact NIST/BIPM factors for 50 quantities, plus engineering, physics and exam calculators.

records.name: SoloSpace
records.tagline: 3D & 2D Virtual Coworking Space for Solopreneurs & Teams
records.description: SoloSpace is a 3D & 2D virtual Coworking space designed for Solopreneurs, One-Person Companies, Startup Founders, Solo Founders, Entrepreneurs, Indie Hackers, Freelancers, and Remote Teams. We bridge the gap between deep focus and real-time social presence.

records.name: Editable GIFs for Discord
records.tagline: Customize GIFs in Discord from curated templates
records.description: Editable GIFs lets you customize and render animated GIFs directly inside your Discord server. Whether you're wishing a server member a Happy Birthday, celebrating a milestone, saying good morning, or sending a festive seasonal greeting, you can tailor text, select colors, and choose fonts without opening an external image editor. 100% In-Discord Experience: Everything happens inside your channel using intuitive slash commands and popups.

records.name: CueHQ
records.tagline: Find people already asking for what you offer
records.description: CueHQ finds the Reddit, X, YouTube and TikTok threads where people ask for what you sell, ranks them by fit and timing, and drafts a reply in your voice. You edit it and post it from your own account. CueHQ never posts for you. Every edit teaches it how you write, and if you add your handles it learns from your posts too. 14 cues free with no card, then from $19 a month. On iOS, Android and the web, with an MCP server for Claude, Cursor and other agents.

records.name: Cooked
records.tagline: Tailor Your CV to Any Job Link with AI
records.description: Paste a job link, add your CV, and Cooked rewrites it around the keywords that role screens for, plus a matching cover letter. Free to try.

records.name: Kontext Studio
records.tagline: AI-Native Data Analysis Workspace
records.description: The AI-native workspace for data analysis. Connect your lakehouse, securely choose your LLM provider, and turn data into actionable insights with agentic workflows.

records.name: Nimbrook
records.tagline: Cheap auto documentation writer alternative
records.description: Record any workflow, polish the manual on A4 pages, and export it to PDF, PowerPoint, Word, Markdown or share it publicly in the web. Run it in the cloud or on your own infrastructure.

records.name: Front-End Checklist
records.tagline: Audit any page against a 400-item front-end checklist
records.description: The Front-End Checklist is a free, open-source audit tool for shipping quality websites. Work through 400 items across 13 sections — accessibility, performance, SEO, security, privacy, testing, and more. Paste any public URL to run up to 246 automatic checks: a score, failures sorted High, Medium, Low, and one-click ticking into your checklist. Plus a free MCP server and agent skill, so your AI assistant can audit, explain failures, fix the code, and re-audit.

records.name: Letronna
records.tagline: An open-source AI agent with its own cloud and wallet
records.description: Letronna is a fast, open-source AI agent built in Rust. Run it locally or in its own cloud to automate tasks, write code, browse the web, and deploy apps. Bring your own models, control your data, and let your agent work anywhere. Intelligence in motion.

records.name: Selfstock
records.tagline: Your life as a stock index, built from Apple Health
records.description: Selfstock turns your steps, sleep and focus from Apple Health into one personal index that starts at 100 and moves every day. Better than your usual day, it goes up. Worse, it goes down. See every day on an up/down calendar, get a recap every Monday, halt trading on sick days, and compare returns with friends in private groups. Everyone is measured only against their own baseline. All health data is calculated on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: MSI Mystic Light for Linux
records.tagline: Pure Rust 24-zone RGB keyboard controller & GUI for Linux.
records.description: The missing RGB keyboard driver and studio GUI for MSI laptops on Linux. Solves the notorious 3-row limit to unlock all 6 physical rows and 24 discrete zones with 16 dynamic presets, custom gradients, gaming cluster targeting, and zero CPU usage.

records.name: Milkbit
records.tagline: Baby feeding tracker the whole family can share
records.description: Simple, pastel baby tracker for iPhone. Log bottles in ml, weight on WHO growth curves and daily vitamins. Invite your partner, grandparents or nanny: everyone sees updates live and gets notified. Widgets show the last feeding at a glance. Free, no ads.

records.name: Luminova
records.tagline: AI Astrology Readings, Horoscope, Compatibility & More
records.description: Discover personalized astrology with Luminova. Get AI-powered daily horoscope readings, explore your natal birth chart, uncover insights through tarot readings, check zodiac compatibility, and discover what the stars have in store. Available on web and Android, Luminova combines astrology calculations with personalized AI interpretations. Enjoy daily readings and unlock additional experiences using Stars earned through optional rewarded ads or purchases.

records.name: SPACE × SELF
records.tagline: Feng Shui Bedroom Layout & Interior Energy Analyzer
records.description: Modern bedroom interior architecture and Eastern Feng Shui spatial harmony analyzer.

records.name: NorthPeak Desk
records.tagline: Offline planner for freelancers: clients, time and outreach
records.description: A calm planner for one-person businesses. Clients, recurring reports, time tracking, a calendar and outreach in one app, with a warning before you contact someone twice. Works offline, stores everything on your device. No account, no subscription. EN/DE.

records.name: CueSpot: Teleprompter
records.tagline: Read scripts, keep eye contact
records.description: Look at the lens. CueSpot holds your words. On iPhone, your script sits right under the front camera. On Mac, just below your webcam. CueSpot follows your voice and scrolls as you speak, so you can pause or ad-lib without losing your place. Speech recognition runs entirely on your device, so nothing you say ever leaves it. Write or import a script, record right in the app and keep real eye contact the whole time.

records.name: OSMEXO AI Model Exchange
records.tagline: The AI Model Exchange that costs less than going direct
records.description: The AI gateway that costs less than going direct. One OpenAI-compatible API for GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi and more, up to 60% below list price. Change the base URL and keep your code: works with any OpenAI SDK, Cline, Roo Code and Aider. Routed only to verified providers, with the cost, speed and savings of every request in view. One prepaid balance for every model, PayPal or card from $5. Start with $0.25 free credit, no card needed.

records.name: Morning Masterpiece
records.tagline: A daily art email that teaches you the artists
records.description: A few masterpieces in your inbox each morning: do you know who made them? Answer with one tap and the piece opens up. Spaced repetition brings back the ones you missed, so you soon know the world's best-known art.

records.name: Habe: everything I want & own
records.tagline: Add in a snap, sort into lists, share with friends
records.description: No more wishlists lost in notes, screenshots and saved posts. Habe keeps everything you want and everything you own in one place. Paste a link from any store and it fills itself in, or snap a photo. Share a list with a link anyone can open in a browser, and friends can reserve gifts so nobody doubles up.

records.name: TripEZGo
records.tagline: Plan the trip, carry what it needs, all in one app
records.description: Plan each day on a calendar; the gap between two events is a leg with travel time estimated. Tickets, to-dos and files sit on the event. Share places in from any app, plan with companions, see the next stop on your Lock Screen. No sign-up, works offline.

records.name: ZAM Academy
records.tagline: Free Coding Roadmap
records.description: Structured coding mentorship for serious beginners: a personal roadmap, private mentor sessions, real projects, code review, progress tracking and Zami AI support. Delivered online, in any time zone.

records.name: Symmetry Mirror & Heatmap
records.tagline: See where your face is asymmetric, drawn on your photo.
records.description: Free AI tool that shows where your face is asymmetric, not just how much. It mirrors 68 facial landmarks across your nose midline and paints the gap onto your photo as a color-coded heatmap: green where your sides agree, red where they differ. Scaled to face width, so photo size doesn't matter. 2 free scans a day, no sign-up, photos deleted right after processing.

records.name: TrustCheck AI
records.tagline: Spot scam warning signs before you act.
records.description: TrustCheck AI helps people spot warning signs in suspicious M-Pesa messages, scam messages, job offers, online earning opportunities and website links. Choose a category, submit a message or link, and receive an automated risk assessment with explanations and safety tips. Starting in Kenya, with English and Kiswahili support.

records.name: ShortenedURL
records.tagline: Shorten Your URLs Instantly at sturl.at
records.description: Create ultra-short, shareable links powered by sturl.at with password protection, custom codes, group URLs, and automatic expiry. Track clicks, manage your URLs, and boost your online presence.

records.name: Approv
records.tagline: Board approvals and voting for Saudi organizations
records.description: Approv helps board secretaries collect approvals within one day instead of days of follow-up. It assigns incoming requests to team members and shows each request's stage from creation to approval or rejection.

records.name: UINQO
records.tagline: From handshake to booked meeting in under two minutes
records.description: You meet hundreds of people. How many do you actually remember? Meet UINQO — your AI-powered networking companion. More than a digital business card, UINQO helps you turn introductions into lasting relationships. Instantly capture contacts through badge scans, QR, NFC, or business cards. Remember who you met, what you discussed, and what comes next. Add notes, set voice reminders, schedule meetings, and follow up smarter. Meet More. Forget Less.

records.name: relifx
records.tagline: Real people. Real conversations. A brighter you.
records.description: Talk to someone who listens without judgment. Anonymous peer-listening.

records.name: Switchy
records.tagline: Mac controls, deploys, 2FA & AI limits in your menu bar
records.description: Mac switches, deploy status, local servers, 2FA codes and Claude/Codex limits in one native menu bar panel. Apple silicon, macOS 14+. Free for 7 days without an account or card, then $4.99 once for up to 3 Macs.

records.name: The Build Nation
records.tagline: The in-person startup network, free
records.description: Meet startup founders, investors and mentors near you, and find startup events worth going to. The in-person startup network, free and open to everyone.

records.name: FontGlint
records.tagline: Font Generator (𝓒𝓸𝓹𝔂 & 𝓟𝓪𝓼𝓽𝓮)
records.description: Free font generator with 500+ copy and paste fonts. Type your text once and get bold, cursive, old english, bubble and aesthetic Unicode font styles.

records.name: Statusline Studio
records.tagline: Design your Claude Code status line with a live preview
records.description: Claude Code can show a line of live info under its prompt: model, git branch, context use, session cost, plan limits. Normally you write a script for it. Statusline Studio lets you design it instead: start from one of 25 templates, add from 75 segments (and 15 for subagent rows) and watch the line render live. Then copy one command that installs the script in Bash, Python or Node.js and turns it on in settings.json. Free, in your browser, no account. Nothing is sent to a server.

records.name: HoMyM
records.tagline: More houses, one app
records.description: Stay on top of your home: systems, maintenance, recurring expenses and documents in one place, with reminders before every deadline. hoMyM is your home’s digital logbook. Keep track of systems, repairs, recurring expenses and documents, and get a reminder before every deadline. Your data stays on your phone.

records.name: Meridian Desk
records.tagline: #AI Market Intelligence, Order Flow & Signals for Traders
records.description: Meridian Desk delivers institutional-grade market intelligence for Forex, Gold (XAU/USD), and Crypto. Featuring real-time liquidity sweep detection, COT positioning, free footprint & Bookmap charts, and a rule-gated MT5 execution bridge.

records.name: Wishlist
records.tagline: Holiday gift exchange, made easy
records.description: Organize a family gift exchange or Secret Santa, share wishlists, and claim gifts without spoiling the surprise. Then explore Main Street: a snowy virtual street with your family's gifts in shop windows. Track what you're buying and wrapping. Optional connections let your own AI helper work with your shopping list. Free to use.

records.name: Kitchen Rush
records.tagline: Free survivors-like: beat bugs, flaky tests and red CI
records.description: A free survivors-like browser game: hold out five minutes against bugs, flaky tests and red CI, with up to three agent cooks on your side (Spec slices, Build throws pans, Review rejects bugs). Level up with faster pans, coffee and a bigger magnet. It runs natively inside X: tap the card in a post and play right there. It's the second game playable in X, after lauren (@poteto)'s tibo.dog. Works on phones too.

records.name: Uulen Print
records.tagline: PrintNode-compatible cloud printing API, free in beta
records.description: Uulen Print lets your app print to real printers anywhere. Install a tiny Windows client next to the printers, pair it with a code, and send PDFs or raw ESC/POS/ZPL jobs through a PrintNode-compatible REST API. Includes sub-accounts for integrators, idempotency keys and job state history. Free during the beta.

records.name: Doppelgone
records.tagline: Clear duplicate photos everywhere and keep the best shot
records.description: Doppelgone finds exact copies, lookalikes and bursts in Google Photos, iCloud Photos, on Windows, Mac, Android and iPhone. It keeps the best shot of each set, you approve every clean-up, and removed photos wait 30 days. Your photos never leave your device.

records.name: Modern Canva Event Signage Kit
records.tagline: 50 locked-layout Canva event signs for conferences & venues
records.description: Stop clients and staff from ruining your event signage layouts. Built for corporate planners and venue owners, this 50-template Canva kit covers every event zone—from registration and breakout rooms to sponsors and wayfinding. Structural lines, typography, and slate-blue icons are rigidly locked in place with dedicated logo and QR placeholders, letting your team type in event info using 100% free Canva elements without ever breaking the design.

records.name: Trendoday
records.tagline: What's trending today on GitHub, HN, Google, Steam and more
records.description: Nine platforms, one ranked list. Trendoday pulls GitHub, Hacker News, Google Trends, Hugging Face, Product Hunt, Steam, the App Store, Spotify, DEV Community and Lobsters every few minutes, scores each item by momentum and merges them into one leaderboard for today, 7 days or 30 days. Filter by Developers, Games, AI, Apps, Music or Products, see where each story came from and whether it is climbing, and copy an embeddable badge for your README. No account needed.

records.name: $1,800 Gift Card Giveaway Rules, Dates
records.tagline: $1,800 Gift Card Giveaway Rules, Dates and Prize
records.description: Read the full rules: who can enter, how the winner is picked, when the prize is sent and what happens if you win.

records.name: TGS Electrical and Lighting
records.tagline: Your Trusted Electrician in Mississauga & Toronto:
records.description: Need an electrician you can actually trust? TGS Electrical serves homeowners and businesses across Mississauga and Toronto. Breaker issues? Dimming lights? Panel upgrades? EV chargers? They'll get it done right the first time. No shortcuts. No surprises. Just honest work from people who care.

records.name: Trucker Numbers
records.tagline: Free profit & cost calculators for owner-operator truckers
records.description: Trucker Numbers is a free collection of financial calculators built specifically for owner-operators and small trucking fleets — no signup, no upsell. What's inside: • Load profit calculator (revenue minus fuel, tolls, broker fees) • Fuel cost & fuel surcharge calculator • IFTA mileage tax calculator • Owner-operator take-home pay calculator • Semi-truck loan & lease vs buy calculator • Freight factoring calculator....

records.name: BlurKit
records.tagline: Blur sensitive data on any web page before screen sharing.
records.description: Blur emails, passwords, customer names and API keys on any web page before you screen share or record. 100% local. Share your screen without sharing your secrets. BlurKit hides sensitive data on any web page in real time: emails, phone numbers, passwords, customer names, card numbers, API keys and more. Blur, hide or mask it right in the browser tab before a screen share, recording, demo or screenshot.

records.name: TranscribeLink
records.tagline: Turn any video link or audio file into a transcript
records.description: Upload audio or video files, or paste a link from YouTube, X, TikTok, Facebook, Vimeo, Dropbox, Google Drive or any audio or video URL. Get a word-for-word transcript in seconds. 20 free minutes, no sign-up.

records.name: SalonOS
records.tagline: Booking, walk-ins and GST billing for Indian salons
records.description: SalonOS is booking and management software for salons, spas, skin clinics and wellness centres in India, for one branch or a whole chain. Customers book online against real staff availability. Walk-ins join a queue that shares the same calendar, so nobody gets double-booked. At the counter you print GST bills with CGST/SGST and per-branch bill numbers. Booking deposits go straight to your own Razorpay account, with no commission. Free forever for one branch.

records.name: UGC Deal Tracker
records.tagline: Track UGC payments, deadlines and usage dates in Excel
records.description: An offline Excel workbook for UGC creators: track 60 deals and 120 assets, partial payments, due dates and content usage terms. Separate USD/EUR/GBP/KZT summaries. One-time $9 download; Windows Excel tested. No macros or subscription.

records.name: Feyo
records.tagline: Your AI personal secretary, one text away.
records.description: Feyo is your AI personal secretary, accessible through a simple text message. We're building an assistant that handles the busywork of everyday life—from reminders, emails, and calendar management to web research, travel planning, bookings, and purchases. No complicated dashboard. Just a conversation with your personal secretary.

records.name: Flux3Max.io
records.tagline: FLUX 3 Max video generator with sound, from text or a photo
records.description: - FLUX 3 Max video with sound from text, one photo (first frame) or two (first and last frame). - 5 to 20 seconds, 720p or 1080p, vertical, square or widescreen. - The price shows next to the button before you start: 36 credits a second at 720p, 62 at 1080p. - A free first clip for new accounts; failed videos are refunded. - One-time credit packs, no subscription, credits do not expire. - Example wall with the exact prompts and a "Use this prompt" button.

records.name: Weekend Studio
records.tagline: Free in-browser creative suite that labels human-made work
records.description: In a feed full of AI, show what you made yourself. Weekend Studio is free creative apps, from images and 3D to design and websites, in any browser on your phone, iPad or computer, with no account. Your work is labeled human-made or AI, and the label travels with it when members post to Cauchii, our social app. Prefer AI? Run it locally with ComfyUI, or as a member use our AI chat or connect your own through MCP. Members also get live collaboration and sync.

records.name: Deesca
records.tagline: Stop having the same fight. A mediator for couples.
records.description: Deesca is a relationship coach and mediator for couples. Put both sides of an argument in, typed or spoken, or invite your partner into a private room. Get back what each of you needs, your common ground and one next step. No winner, no blame.

records.name: Echoa
records.tagline: Speak a language in weeks, not years. Learning. Accelerated.
records.description: Your speaking bootcamp. Short, focused lessons where you do the talking: Sam explains in English, a native voice demonstrates, you answer out loud and Echoa listens. Each new piece combines with what you already know, so you soon say things you were never taught. Six Foundation Courses to A2: German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian and Dutch. The first three lessons in each are free.

records.name: Chispot
records.tagline: Turn real-world places into social communities
records.description: Think of a place you love: your gym, a basketball court, a park, a campus, a café, your favorite spot in nature, a hangout with friends, or even a party. Find it on the map, create a Chispot, choose its size, and decide who can discover it or see what's inside. The catch? You have to be physically within the Chispot's boundary to post photos or videos. Real places, real people, real moments.

records.name: Lejar
records.tagline: AI accounting software for Malaysian small businesses
records.description: Cloud accounting for Malaysian small businesses. Drop a receipt, bill or bank statement into the AI Inbox and Lejar drafts the journal entry. You approve every entry before it posts. MPERS, SST-02 and MyInvois e-invoicing built in. Free plan available.

records.name: crooom
records.tagline: Swipe destinations with friends and match on one trip
records.description: crooom ends the "so where are we going?" group chat. Everyone swipes through 240+ curated destinations on their own phone, and a place becomes a match when every single person liked it. No perfect match? crooom falls back to the places almost everyone liked. Then plan the trip together in the same app: day-by-day activities, shared expenses, a map, a group photo album and a document safe. For iOS and Android, in English and German.

records.name: Chinese Idioms Almanac
records.tagline: Chinese idioms with context, flashcards and widgets
records.description: Learn Chinese idioms with English meanings, pinyin, usage notes and four examples each. The iPhone and iPad app offers offline reading, search, saved idioms, flashcard review and four Home Screen widget styles. Start with the free collection; optional one-time Almanac Pro unlocks the full app collection and topic browsing. No app account required. Browse the free website idiom library, too.

records.name: Overboard
records.tagline: Run Claude Code agents on your Mac 24/7
records.description: Overboard is a Mac app that runs Claude Code agents on your own Mac, 24/7. Agents are organized into departments with a "Captain" agent - each captain has the ability to spawn agents or change the direction of the ship. Every run of ship captains or agents are a real Claude Code session you can pick up again. Everything runs on your existing Claude Pro or Ultra plan.

records.name: Dot Clash: 1v1 Strategy Duel
records.tagline: Dots and boxes, rebuilt as a real-time strategy duel
records.description: A real-time strategy game on a grid of dots. Take turns placing dots, close a ring around your rival's, and everything inside is yours. Play a live opponent, a friend or the daily puzzle, free in your browser with no sign-up. Crypto 1 vs 1 on the web.

records.name: cfg-guard
records.tagline: Guard config edits with flock
records.description: Guard config edits with flock and a content-hash precondition; observe Linux file changes through inotify and /proc. Python standard library; offline selfcheck. Written in Python. Open source, MIT. Source, docs and issue tracker: https://gitlab.com/ameobius-ai/cfg-guard

records.name: Debatify
records.tagline: Debatify turns the day's news into two-sided debates
records.description: Most news apps leave you scrolling. Debatify turns the day's headlines into something you take part in. Each day you get a curated set of stories, each framed as a two-sided debate. Pick for or against - once you pick, there's no switching. Make your case in 180 characters, defend it, and watch the split move in real time. No endless threads, no pile-ons, no algorithm deciding what you see. One story, two sides, your argument on the record. Free.

records.name: Spritix
records.tagline: Turn characters into game-ready sprite animations
records.description: Spritix is an AI sprite generator that turns one character image into a reusable 2D action library. Generate Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, and Attack, then trim frames, adjust speed, and refine loops without spending generation credits. Export sprite sheets, GIFs, Atlas JSON, and PNG frames for Godot, Unity, and Phaser. Built for indie game developers, with version history and per-action export settings. Start with 20 free credits and downloads for two generations each month.

records.name: Daily Pet Photos
records.tagline: A new AI photo of your pet in your inbox every day
records.description: Add your pet once with one clear photo. Every morning for 7 days you get a new AI scene of them by email, like barista, surfer or detective, then one every week. Free, no card needed. Likeness comes first: 23 details are read from your photos and every picture is scored, so anything below 7/10 is made again. Love the results? Turn them into a printed 2027 wall calendar, approve every page, from €39 with free shipping.

records.name: Recompyle.dev
records.tagline: URL in. PRD (and AGENTS.md) out. Build it with one prompt.
records.description: Recompyle bridges the gap between the live web and autonomous AI engineers. With a single URL input, Recompyle’s reverse-engineering engine inspects network flows, DOM structures, and AST patterns to decompile a live web app into a comprehensive, agent-ready blueprint across 10 architectural dimensions. Feed the exported markdown directly into Cursor, Claude, Windsurf, or custom agent harnesses to scaffold functional clones, audits, migrations, and feature extensions in minutes instead of weeks.

records.name: Plenty
records.tagline: The shared grocery list for your household
records.description: Plenty is a shared grocery list that updates in real time for everyone in your household. Add items by typing, barcode or voice, keep loyalty cards ready, set a grocery budget, scan receipts and turn recipes into your list.

records.name: GeeksFinder
records.tagline: Fresher jobs matched to your resume, on Telegram
records.description: Fresher jobs matched to your skills, on Telegram every morning. Tailor your resume and email HR in one click. Free to start; paid plans from ₹10 per 15 days.

records.name: RoutixAI
records.tagline: One API key for 40+ AI models at up to 75% off
records.description: OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API for Claude, GPT-6, Grok, Gemini, Kimi, DeepSeek and 40+ more. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Cline by changing the base URL. Free tier, web chat and live uptime for every model

records.name: HUM Music: Voice Notes (No AI)
records.tagline: Anti Gen-AI Policy
records.description: Capture your musical ideas and build on them effortlessly. HUM will NEVER encourage the use of Gen-AI in the creative process. HUM is a tool created to serve Human creativity. From the hammerstone to the space rocket, technology will always be a tool meant to serve The Human Creative. Please help us fight against fake art.

records.name: Notch
records.tagline: A shooting coach with Olympic precision
records.description: Scoring shooting targets is time-consuming, so Notch automates that using on-device Core ML models. It also helps you nail the fundamentals from the shape of your groups - a low-right cluster usually means trigger pull, a vertical string means breathing, and so on. It coaches you through heat maps and per-rifle trends over a season, shows heart rate from the Apple Watch and a live score in the Dynamic Island, and keeps track of your inventory.

records.name: PausePal: Block Reels & Shorts
records.tagline: Block Reels & Shorts — keep the app, kill the scroll
records.description: PausePal adds a mindful pause before YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels and Snapchat Spotlight open. It blocks only the addictive feed — chats, DMs and the rest of the app keep working. Streaks, friction unlock, scheduled blocking and an AI Coach. Free on Android.

records.name: Chess Rapid
records.tagline: Play Chess Online Free
records.description: Play chess online for free against real people or the computer. Rated Rapid and Blitz, a new ranked season every two weeks, daily puzzles and lessons. On the web, iPhone and Android.

records.name: Emoji Kingdom: Merge & Build
records.tagline: Merge emoji, Fill citizen orders. Rebuild a broken kingdom.
records.description: 👑 Welcome to Emoji Kingdom – Merge & Build! A mysterious glitch has shattered the Emoji Kingdom, and only you can restore it! Merge adorable emoji items, complete orders, unlock magical producers, and rebuild a vibrant kingdom filled with charming characters and hidden treasures. Combine matching items to discover new evolutions and rare creations. Fill your collection book with 400+ items to find, and watch every merge bring your kingdom closer to greatness.

records.name: Uncle Ref
records.tagline: Your game. The good bits. On repeat.
records.description: Turn match footage into replays worth keeping. Record or import a game, save player names, confirm scores, choose your clips and export a captioned highlight reel. Link nearby compatible iPhones for more camera angles. Your footage stays on your devices. No account required.

records.name: Soolo
records.tagline: Breathing, grounding, and a journal for anxious moments
records.description: Soolo brings guided breathing, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding, a panic journal, mood check-ins, and conversations with Umay into one place. Open it when anxiety feels overwhelming or use it for a quiet daily pause. Start for free on iOS or Android; some features require Soolo Pro.

records.name: Panel & Ink
records.tagline: Turn one idea into a comic series, no drawing needed
records.description: Start with one idea. Panel and Ink turns it into a comic series. Type a premise, pick one of 28 looks, and the studio writes the script, casts your characters and draws the issue panel by panel. The same characters come back issue after issue, so it reads like a series, not a pile of one-off pictures. Review every panel and ask for another take before it's final. Your first issue is free.

records.name: Global Swanky
records.tagline: Waist Bags Discover Convenience Style and Everyday Versatile
records.description: Waist bags are a stylish and practical choice for carrying your everyday essentials while keeping your hands free. Perfect for travel, shopping, casual outings, festivals, and they offer convenient storage in a compact design. Choose from trendy waist bags in black, brown, beige, pink, and other colors to match your personal style. (https://www.globalswanky.com/collections/waist-bags) and discover fashionable everyday accessories at [Global Swanky](https://www.globalswanky.com/).

records.name: PommeToys
records.tagline: Everyday Mac tools with an interface inspired by Dieter Rams
records.description: Small fixes for windows, the Dock and the mouse, in one Mac app whose settings window is built like a piece of hardware. Dock previews, Mission Control window controls, smooth reversible mouse scrolling, Keep Awake (even with the lid closed), Dock reveal speed. Shake a window to hide the rest. Click the active app's Dock icon to minimize it. The design is inspired by Dieter Rams, down to a fax-machine feedback window. You can try a copy of the settings window on the website.

records.name: Mulan
records.tagline: Four reading themes for Safari, with per-site controls
records.description: Give Safari a calmer look on iPhone and iPad. Choose Soft Dark, Black, Warm Gray or Paper, adjust supported images, and save a different appearance for each website. Settings stay on your device. No account, subscription or in-app purchases. US App Store: $0.99 once.

records.name: Personalized Christmas Gifts for Dad
records.tagline: Custom tumblers, towels & photo blankets for dad & grandpa
records.description: Shop personalized Christmas gifts for dad and grandpa with functional daily keepsakes: photo travel tumblers, embroidered golf towels, and family fleece blankets, with practical ordering tips directly on https://homestorie.com/blog/personalized-christmas-gifts-for-dad-and-grandpa-2026

records.name: QuiltMac
records.tagline: "Windows that tidy themselves"
records.description: Quilt arranges your Mac windows for you. Open a window and it takes its place; close one and the rest fill the gap. Choose Grid, Columns, Rows or Side, with up to five windows per screen and a separate layout for each display. Extra windows stack in a tile, Focus fills the screen with one window, and every shortcut can be changed. Needs only the Accessibility permission. No account, no analytics. One payment.

records.name: PitchGym – Sing in tune
records.tagline: Ear trainer for people who want improve their singing
records.description: PitchGym is a friendly singing and ear training app which helps you sing in tune with personalized ear training, interactive vocal exercises, and real-time pitch feedback. Here's how PitchGym helps: - See exactly how closely you're matching the notes. - Practice notes, intervals, melodies, and pitch memory. - Follow your improvements and build a consistent singing habit. Discover your vocal range, practice at your own pace, and see your singing improve — one note at a time.

records.name: Memish
records.tagline: Meme-only chat app for iPhone and Android. Say it with memes
records.description: Memish is a free meme-only chat app for iPhone and Android. Search by vibe (“brain empty,” “awkward silence”), build oddly specific memes from your camera roll, and trade reactions with your favorite weirdos—with zero pressure to form an actual sentence.

records.name: Puley
records.tagline: Let ChatGPT and Claude read web pages and watch them
records.description: Puley is an add-on for ChatGPT, Claude and other AI apps. It reads public pages your AI is usually locked out of, compares prices across countries, turns pages into tables and emails you when a page changes. Free plan available.

records.name: Removication
records.tagline: Not everyone should see your private notifications
records.description: Your phone screen isn't always just yours. Removication hides notifications from the apps you choose – from the screen, the shade and the lock screen. One tap on a widget or in Quick Settings, and they're gone; even the ones already showing. Nothing is lost: everything waits in the Notification Catcher. Hide a whole app or only certain kinds, set time windows, or censor to a neutral "1 new notification". No account, no cloud. Calls and alarms always get through.

records.name: Monolith Workbench
records.tagline: Built For Technical Documents
records.description: Monolith Workbench is a native desktop application that replaces the traditional dual-pane LaTeX split screen with a continuous visual paged workspace. You edit complex math, layout, and document structure directly on a live canvas, no manual compile step required—while seamless background rendering generates production-ready PDFs or exportable LaTeX source behind the scenes.

records.name: GetFromEU
records.tagline: A directory of manufacturers selling products made in EU.
records.description: Hundreds of small businesses across Europe make their products locally and sell them through their own websites. Many of them don't have big budgets for SEO or marketing, which makes them harder to find. GetFromEU doesn't sell products, handle orders, or earn commissions. The directory brings these stores together in one directory, making it easier to discover European brands and buy directly from the people who make the products.

records.name: Ideograph Ai
records.tagline: Craft Scripts Like Never Before
records.description: Assalam-o-Alaikum everyone, Over the last few months, I noticed a massive problem whenever Pakistani YouTubers or freelance scriptwriters use ChatGPT/Claude to write Urdu or Hinglish scripts: So I built Ideograph — a full-stack Creator Script & Visual Direction Studio. Feel free to try.

records.name: Yükledim
records.tagline: Post a load. Truck drivers bid. You pick the best offer
records.description: Yükledim is an online freight and transport marketplace that connects cargo owners with truck drivers. A cargo owner posts their shipment, drivers submit offers, the cargo owner accepts a suitable offer, and the transport process can be tracked via the platform. Available on web and mobile (iOS and Android), in Turkish, English and German.

records.name: nochase.app
records.tagline: https://nochase.app
records.description: Get paid on time without the awkward chase. NoChase is for freelancers and solo founders who hate writing "just following up on the invoice" emails. It generates polite, escalating AI reminder sequences — a heads-up before the due date and firm but professional follow-ups after. You review and approve every single email before anything is sent. No black-box automation. Free to start. Set up in 2 minutes.

records.name: pdf2text
records.tagline: Turn PDFs, scans and bank statements into Excel or text
records.description: pdf2text turns PDFs, scans and phone photos into Excel, CSV, JSON, Word or text with AI OCR. Bank statements get a running-balance check and QuickBooks/Xero CSV exports. First page of every document free; pay once from $9 or subscribe.

records.name: Puffer Pup: Shared Pet Widget
records.tagline: A shared corgi that lives on your friends' Home Screens
records.description: Puffer Pup is a corgi in a puffer jacket you raise with up to 4 friends. Care for it from a widget, take it on walks in the Dynamic Island, play Hide the Bone and Treat Catch, dress it in 40+ fits. It never dies. No ads, free on iPhone.

records.name: DZX STUDIO
records.tagline: A native Mac IDE for ZX Spectrum with tools from the future.
records.description: Create, build, run and debug Sinclair BASIC and Z80 projects for ZX Spectrum 48K and 128K in a professional native Mac IDE.

records.name: PayRekha
records.tagline: Stops attackers moving money with your own payout API
records.description: PayRekha is an open-source payout firewall. Every outbound payout (loan disbursal, settlement, refund, crypto withdrawal) must match a signed business reason, or it doesn't move, even if attackers hold your keys. Runs in your cloud. No telemetry.

records.name: LeadPilotOS
records.tagline: An insurance agency CRM built for the sales floor
records.description: LeadPilotOS is built for independent insurance agencies that work leads by phone. Many CRMs require separate calling tools or custom insurance workflows; LeadPilotOS brings them together. Its auto-dialer rings the agent first, then calls two leads at once. Track leads, callbacks, customers, policies, and sales by agent and lead source in one workspace. AI Call Copilot suggests notes after recorded calls for review (CallHarbor accounts). Calls and texts are billed separately by your providers.

records.name: SeniorPaw
records.tagline: A calm daily log for older dogs and cats
records.description: SeniorPaw is a calm daily log for senior dogs and cats: a 30-second check-in, medicine reminders, a one-tap seizure timer, weight and breathing logs, and a clear PDF to share with your vet. No sign-up, no ads. It doesn't diagnose.

records.name: MobileScreen MCP
records.tagline: Your coding agent now designs your App Store screenshots
records.description: Turn raw simulator captures into App Store and Google Play screenshot sets. 2.0 rebuilds the design engine: it measures your brand colors, commits to one of seven looks, writes a headline per screen and transcreates it into 50 languages with real font fitting. New MCP server: Claude Code, Cursor or Codex generate the set, edit any word or device, look at the renders and export to fastlane. Then push to App Store Connect with name, subtitle and keywords.

records.name: Goldgrain Studio
records.tagline: Five hooks. One week. Find the ad that wins.
records.description: Done-for-you AI video ads for Shopify beauty and wellness brands: five hooks in 7 business days, creator-style, in five languages. Plus launch films, YouTube channels and white-label production for agencies.

records.name: PNG Converter Hub
records.tagline: Free online image converters and handy tools — no signup
records.description: Free online tools: convert PNG, JPG, WebP and HEIC images in bulk, compress and resize images, remove EXIF and photo location data, plus a font generator, a face age guesser, an Illinois paycheck calculator, a car sales tax calculator and developer tools (JWT decoder, HAR sanitizer, SRT to VTT converter). Every tool runs 100% in the browser.

records.name: Supplier Comparison Toolkit
records.tagline: Compare supplier quotes by landed cost
records.description: Compare supplier quotes in your browser using landed unit cost, lead time, quality, and reliability. Set your own weights, see why a quote ranks or misses the minimum order quantity, and export the results. The free beta needs no account and includes a fictional demo. It currently compares one item at a time in a shared currency.

records.name: Apex City
records.tagline: City builder, airport, Android, iOS
records.description: Zone land, construct buildings, and manage resources like power, water, and traffic to grow a living city. Balance residential, commercial, and industrial sectors to meet RCI demand while keeping citizens happy and pollution in check. Adjust map overlays and terrain to optimize land value and net income as your population and jobs expand. Step out of City Hall to walk, ride, or drive through your creation. Explore the streets you have built at eye level.

records.name: Infograph
records.tagline: Paste any text. Get a story people read to the last line.
records.description: Most people read about 20% of a web page. Infograph turns any text, like an article, a ChatGPT answer, class notes or a meeting transcript, into a scrolling visual story people finish. Instant draws each card as a chart or diagram in about 15 seconds, or you can add an AI picture to every card. Every number comes from your source. Share a link, or export a carousel, PDF or video with voice-over, in 26 languages. Free to try, no card needed.

records.name: Footgun
records.tagline: Find, save and paste every API key, without the hassle
records.description: Every app needs API keys, and getting them is a chore: find the right page, create the key, copy it before it disappears, paste it into the right file, keep it safe, and start over when you lose it. Footgun is a Chrome extension for Mac that highlights each click on the service's real dashboard, catches the key the moment it appears, saves it in your Mac's Keychain and puts it in your project. 20 services, including OpenAI, Stripe and Supabase.

records.name: Koschei Lang
records.tagline: Capability-secure programming language
records.description: A pre-1.0 capability-secure programming language with explicit disk, network, environment and process authority, security diagnostics, and a native build path.

records.name: Puffer Party
records.tagline: Independent category hot potato for 2–16 friends
records.description: Free category hot potato for 2–16 friends: private browser rooms, adjustable timers and labelled BOT practice. Repeatable rounds, no download or required signup. Independent Krillion-inspired edition; see About for credits and artwork provenance.

records.name: SpriteSkin
records.tagline: AI Minecraft Skin Generator: Photo or Text to Skin
records.description: Free and AI-powered tools for Minecraft Skin: turn a photo or text into a playable skin. 64×64 PNG for Java, HD 128×128mcpack for Bedrock, 3D preview. 3 free skins.

records.name: Distilled Editions
records.tagline: Comics for language learning.
records.description: Comics for language learning in Spanish, French, German and Italian. Graded beginner stories with scene visuals, audio and one-tap translation. Start free.

records.name: abaixou.com
records.tagline: Cupons e Promoções: Amazon, Mercado Livre e Shopee
records.description: Cupons e promoções em tempo real na Amazon, Mercado Livre e Shopee. Ofertas atualizadas o dia todo, com histórico de preço, no abaixou.com.

records.name: StockMail
records.tagline: Daily AI email that explains your stock watchlist
records.description: Your watchlist, explained. Every trading day, about 2 hours after the US open, StockMail sends a short AI brief: live price, why each stock is moving, analyst counts and price target, and a Buy-to-Sell verdict, ranked best buy first. Price alerts too.

records.name: TaskSlice
records.tagline: AI breaks big tasks into small steps you can start now
records.description: TaskSlice is for the task you keep putting off. Type it or say it, in any language, and AI breaks it into 3-5 concrete steps with time estimates, fitted to your country. Then it helps you finish: a focus timer, an "I'm stuck" button that makes a step even smaller, reminders that open into focus, and a widget with your next step. Lots on your mind? Brain dump it all into separate tasks. Free on Android, no account needed, no ads.

records.name: Shelv
records.tagline: Check if ChatGPT can read your online store's products
records.description: Shoppers increasingly ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity what to buy. Shelv scans one product page of your online store and shows what an AI assistant can actually read: name, price, stock, barcode (EAN/GTIN), brand, shipping and returns. You get 15 checks, each with a plain-language fix and paste-ready product data. Free, no account. Paid plans add automatic monitoring of 10 or 50 product pages. Built in the Netherlands for small and mid-sized stores.

records.name: Vector
records.tagline: App-first longevity care that catches what "normal" hides
records.description: Australian longevity care is clinic-first and runs on appointments. Vector is app-first. Bring every blood test you've had, plus Apple Health. Vector detects patterns across years, even drift inside "normal", and builds a plan that learns from your check-ins, questions and actions. A doctor steps in when needed. Records stored in Australia, never sold or used to train AI. Free on iPhone; Vitality adds an advanced blood test every 3 months and a video consult with an Australian-registered doctor.

records.name: Zelbi
records.tagline: Give away what you no longer use with one photo
records.description: Zelbi helps families facing rising costs get things they need, free, from people nearby. Snap one photo of something you no longer use, Zelbi writes the listing, and someone close by claims it. Items are always free and givers pay nothing. Your exact address stays private: the map shows only an approximate area, and only the claimer sees the exact spot. Chat stays in the app with no phone numbers or emails shared, and every claim is tied to a real account. Live across Seattle and nearby cities.

records.name: gasrent
records.tagline: TRON energy and bandwidth rental aggregator with a REST API
records.description: gasrent compares TRON energy and bandwidth rental providers and delegates energy to your address. Pay in TRX with no KYC. Public prices need no key. Quotes and orders use a free API key. MIT examples cover Node.js, Python, and PHP.

records.name: dmhouse agency
records.tagline: Digital Marketing & Website Design Agency
records.description: DM House is a digital marketing agency helping businesses grow their online presence through professional website design, SEO, and strategic digital marketing solutions. We combine creativity, technology, and data-driven strategies to build effective digital experiences, improve search visibility, and support sustainable business growth.

records.name: Prodular UI
records.tagline: a React design system for AI-built software
records.description: A design system for React built on shadcn/ui and Base UI: 162 components, 21 complete SaaS screens, ten themes, a CLI and an MCP server that coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor use to build with it.

records.name: Stay at Spa
records.tagline: Discover handpicked luxury spa hotels worth the journey
records.description: Stay at Spa helps you discover and book spa and wellness hotels around the world. Explore thermal spa resorts, wellness retreats and luxury spa hotels, with a focus on Europe and destinations beyond. Find your next relaxing getaway in one place.

records.name: Exhibo.art
records.tagline: Never miss a show: follow contemporary art in 34 cities
records.description: Exhibo.art is a global art gallery and culture platform covering 34 cities. Follow a city, a gallery or an artist, save the shows you want to see and get exhibition alerts. It covers 2,000+ galleries and museums worldwide, from New York, Berlin, Paris and Tokyo to Dubai, Riyadh, Cairo and Beirut where we started. City guides and articles add context. Free to browse. Galleries claim their pages for free.

records.name: WhatRunsIndia
records.tagline: AI ads & product photoshoots for Shopify catalogs
records.description: Turn your Shopify catalog into an always-on creative studio. WhatRunsIndia helps D2C brands generate on-brand ad creatives and studio-quality product photoshoots directly from their existing product catalog. Free and self-hostable.

records.name: Duly

records.name: Quest

Not another assistant telling you what to do, but a thoughtful advisor helping you find your own path.

records.name: ClarifierAI for Chrome

records.name: Standflow
records.tagline: Sit, stand, perch, and move on a rhythm from your menu bar
records.description: Standflow is a standing desk timer that lives in your Mac's menu bar. Start from a preset like Easy Start, based on the 20-8-2 guideline, or drag the cycle ring to build your own. Reminders can move on automatically or ask first. records.name: seam

records.name: Muse Realtime Avatar

records.description: Muse Realtime Avatar gives Meta's Muse agent a face you can video chat with. records.name: Google Omni 1.2 Flash

records.name: sipnik

records.name: Sur Music

records.description: Sur Music is a free live radio player that runs in any browser, with an Android app and a Chrome extension. records.name: CETverse

Test Series: Study Material: Performance Analytics: Doubt Solving: Gamification: Subscription Plans: User and Test Management: Elevate your CET preparation with The CETverse, and experience a dynamic, interactive, and comprehensive approach to exam success.

records.name: PactMe
