records.tagline: مولّد أسماء مزخرفة لجميع المنصات
records.description: أفضل أداة زخرفة أسماء لإنشاء أسماء مزخرفة لفيسبوك وببجي وفري فاير ووسائل التواصل الاجتماعي بخطوط ورموز مميزة.

records.name: Lateling
records.tagline: Spot late Shopify orders and answer "where is it?" fast
records.description: Lateling lists the orders that look late or stuck, finds any customer's order by email or order number, and fills in a reply with their name, order number and tracking. It works inside your Shopify admin, with an optional Gmail add-on. Free plan available.

records.name: zipprr Udemy Clone
records.tagline: White-label course marketplace you own, launched in days
records.description: Zipprr’s Udemy Clone is a white-label online course marketplace with HD video, multi-instructor dashboards, quizzes, certificates, subscriptions and automatic instructor revenue splits. Own the full source code. One-time $490, no commissions. Topics: Education, Online Education, Marketplaces

records.name: Contractor Marketing
records.tagline: Every lead from a contractor's site, on their phone
records.description: An iPhone app for contractors. When a homeowner fills in the form on a contractor's website, the lead is on the owner's phone the same minute, with their words, photos, budget and the search that found the business. One tap calls, texts or books the site walk. Signed jobs sit next to what the ads cost. Free with every site Contractor Marketing NW builds.

records.name: Diamond Smart Ring
records.tagline: Jewellery that cares
records.description: Discover Aurique smart jewellery featuring wellness tracking, elegant smart rings and bracelets, long battery life and water-resistant designs for modern lifestyles.

records.name: Frettle
records.tagline: Fretboard Visualizer for Guitar, Bass, Ukulele & Mandolin
records.description: Frettle is a free, open source app that shows every note, chord shape and scale on the neck of a guitar, bass, ukulele or mandolin. Pick a chord to see all the ways to play it up the neck, with the root and intervals marked and barres drawn in. Pick a scale to see it across the whole fretboard, split into hand-sized groups, along with the chords that fit it. Tap any note to hear it.

records.name: InspeQtR
records.tagline: QR Code inspection utility
records.description: InspeQtR allows you to scan QR codes with your camera or from an image, then shows you a clear breakdown based on its format, along with the raw content and technical metadata. * Breaks URLs into their components, previews vCards, emails and more * Shows QR metadata like ECL, version,. * Warns about unsafe content * Lets you open, copy, or share content, even as an actual file when there's a matching format Everything runs locally. No ads, no tracking.

records.name: ClickBasic
records.tagline: Free online tools suite
records.description: Comprehensive suite of free, high-performance online utility tools running securely in the browser.

records.name: PDF & Doc Suite
records.tagline: Free PDF/Word viewers and powerful PDF tools.
records.description: Tired of slow, ad-filled document tools? Meet PDF & Doc Suite—your fast, offline-ready cross-platform workspace. ​✨ Free Essentials: PDF/Word viewers & Doc Creator are 100% free. 🛠️ Pro Toolkit: Easily split, merge, compress, and edit PDFs locally. 💻📱 Cross-Platform: Available on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, & Web PWA. 💎 Pricing: 3 free trial uses, then just $2/mo or $20/yr for unlimited Pro access!

records.name: chatview
records.tagline: Turn WhatsApp, iMessage and SMS chats into clean PDFs
records.description: Open WhatsApp, iMessage, Android SMS, Telegram, Instagram and ChatGPT exports in your browser. Search, redact and see stats for free, then pay once for a clean PDF or a numbered Evidence Pack. Chat files never leave your device. No account.

records.name: Flowkidz
records.tagline: Tiny tech games that teach kids how the digital world works
records.description: Short browser games that show kids how the digital world works. Pick a world (Design, Websites, AI, Code or Internet), play a game, and learn one idea in a few minutes. Kids mix colors on a graffiti wall, rebuild a messy website, teach a robot to paint and hunt bugs in code. Free to play, no account needed.

records.name: Rabi
records.tagline: Discord introductions, welcome cards and community tools
records.description: A Korean-first Discord bot with a web dashboard for introduction forms, submitted messages, welcome cards, reaction roles, temporary voice rooms, parties and private inquiries. Public beta with setup guides available before sign-in.

records.name: Lullaby Converter
records.tagline: Turn any song into editable music-box lullabies
records.description: Tired of "wheels on the bus" and "clare de lune"? instead, make a soothing lullaby version of your favorite song to listen to with your baby. Turn an audio file, YouTube link, or Spotify link into a music-box lullaby. Adjust instruments, mix and tempo in your browser. Hear a short preview free, then pay once to unlock the full arrangement for export and sharing.

records.name: AI Rap Video Spot
records.tagline: Turn one or two photos into a 15-second AI rap video
records.description: Add one photo for a solo rap or two for a duo, write your own lyrics or start from a template, and hear the song before you make the video. Then pick a stage and download a 15-second vertical MP4. No sign-up or subscription. Credit packs from $9.99.

records.name: Ledger of Deeds
records.tagline: Write what you did, an AI Judge reads it
records.description: A progress ledger where you write what you did and an AI Judge decides what it is worth in XP. Ledger of Deeds is a ledger of what you actually do. Write down what you did, in a sentence or with a photo, and the Judge reads it, scores it against your own recent work, and tells you why. Level up, earn titles, and add up to your character.

records.name: LaiCai Screen Mirroring
records.tagline: Mirror and control Android phones from Windows or Mac
records.description: Mirror and control Android phones and supported emulators on Windows or Mac over USB or Wi-Fi. Map keyboard, mouse, or gamepad inputs, control devices in groups, record macros, and build no-code workflows with LaiCai Flow. Free for up to 3 devices.

records.name: FormulaQuest
records.tagline: Learn Excel by doing. Not watching
records.description: Interactive spreadsheet missions that teach Excel, from first formula to dynamic arrays.

records.name: Voxel3D
records.tagline: Turn one image into an exportable 3D model
records.description: Turn one image into a textured 3D model in your browser. Rotate and inspect the result, then export GLB or OBJ. Start with a free rapid preview or buy credits for standard and PBR models.

records.name: Sojourner
records.tagline: A personal system for showing up.
records.description: Build consistency across your everyday life. Sojourner brings training, nutrition, habits, and health together in one private, on-device experience.

records.name: Discky
records.tagline: Find what eats your Mac's disk. Clean it, or let your agent,
records.description: Find what is eating your Mac's disk and clear it safely, by hand or through an AI agent.Discky finds the junk that fills a Mac - AI models apps downloaded quietly, build folders coding agents left behind, dead caches — explains each item, and removes it only through the tool that owns it. Free, open source, with an MCP server for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

records.name: Ptarmigan Flow
records.tagline: Push-to-talk dictation for macOS — 100% on-device
records.description: Hold a hotkey, speak, release — your words are transcribed and pasted into whatever app you're using. Ptarmigan Flow is a push-to-talk dictation daemon for macOS that runs speech recognition entirely on-device with Moonshine, so no audio ever leaves your Mac.

records.name: How to Win a $1,800 Gift Card: 3 Simple
records.tagline: How to Win a $1,800 Gift Card: 3 Simple Steps
records.description: Fill in the form, share the page and leave a comment for bonus entries. Free to enter for readers in 7 eligible countries.

records.name: IAMQA
records.tagline: AI Test Automation Services
records.description: Enterprise AI test automation with self-healing locators, visual AI regression, and parallel Dockerized execution. Reduce regression time by 75%. Book a free audit.

records.name: Fylora
records.tagline: One offline app to open, edit and convert files on Windows
records.description: Fylora is an all-in-one file app for Windows 10 and 11. Browse folders in tabs and open documents, spreadsheets, slides, PDFs, photos, music, video, e-books, archives, code and SQLite databases. Edit many of them, batch convert media and tables, and use Mini Apps like Disk Usage, Duplicates and Compare. Your files stay on your PC and are never uploaded.

records.name: GetShorts
records.tagline: AI-powered video generator that creates UGC
records.description: AI-powered video generator that creates UGC-style video ads and story videos using lifelike AI avatars, voice cloning, and auto-captions.

records.name: Terms of Surrender
records.tagline: Do you Read what you agree to?
records.description: An evidence-first Agreements/ EULA analyzer. Extract key clauses, hidden dark patterns, and user obligations. By highlighting specific evidence directly from the text, the tool helps users quickly understand exactly what they are agreeing to without having to sift through pages of dense legal jargon.

records.name: Fimvory
records.tagline: A cozy daily planner that turns tasks into quests
records.description: Plan your day around the energy you have. Turn everyday tasks into quests, make time for rituals and breaks, and watch your little pixel world grow alongside your Fim companion. Unfinished quests don’t cost you progress.

records.name: AI Headshot Generator Pro
records.tagline: Turn any photo into professional AI headshots inside ChatGPT
records.description: Turn a casual photo into a professional headshot inside ChatGPT. Start free with three curated looks, or unlock every look with a one-time Pro license.

records.name: Desi Bus Simulator: Van Game
records.tagline: Offline 3D desi bus game where everyone speaks Punjabi
records.description: Drive a bus through fictional Punjabi villages and city bazaars. Pick up passengers, follow GPS arrows, earn tips at chai stalls, and hear Punjabi voices react to your driving. 1,000 levels, 8 vehicles, plays offline, no account needed.

records.name: ResumeFit
records.tagline: ATS Resume Tailor & Job Match Score
records.description: Paste your resume and a job post. Get an ATS match score, a tailored resume, honest skill gaps, and 3 likely interview questions. Never invents experience.

records.name: Atlas of Posters
records.tagline: Maps & posters from every corner of the world
records.description: An interactive world map of community-shared maps and posters.

records.name: AgentPulse
records.tagline: Track LLM price changes & breaking SDK updates for agent .
records.description: AgentPulse watches the shifting rules your production agents depend on: silent LLM price hikes, framework deprecations, and breaking SDK changes. Get a normalized event timeline, token cost simulator, free weekly digest and RSS feed. Team plans add threshold alerts, webhook, Slack & Discord notifications. This is not a tracing tool. It’s ecosystem intelligence, built to prevent surprise bills and outages before they hit your agent workload.

records.name: freedesignmd
records.tagline: Open-source design library and UX/UI lexicon for vibe-coders
records.description: Free open-source DESIGN library with free landing pages, design systems, components and a UI / UX lexicon for vibe-coding using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Lovable, v0, and others. No signup.

records.name: Horror Paint and Seek
records.tagline: Paint yourself into the walls. Hide from two monsters.
records.description: A 3D stealth horror game where you paint your body to match patterned walls. Explore a dark facility, prepare your camouflage, and stay still as two monsters hunt you. Survive for 120 seconds, but don't let them get too close. Available for Windows for $2.99.

records.name: StorkPlus
records.tagline: AI-first e-commerce platform for social shoppers
records.description: StorkPlus is an AI-first store builder for brands that sell on Messenger, WhatsApp and Instagram. Its AI agent answers customers and takes orders from live stock, applies your promotions, and checks every order against fake-order rules before you ship.

records.name: Frilo Bridge
records.tagline: Home Services Platform
records.description: Frilo Bridge LLP is a convenient digital platform designed to connect customers with trusted service providers for moving, home improvement, interior design, home maintenance and property services—all in one app. Whether you are shifting to a new home, renovating your existing home, looking for a professional service provider, or searching for a property to buy, rent or sell, Frilo Bridge LLP helps you manage your requirements from one convenient platform.

records.name: BondStats Relay
records.tagline: Build automations you can test, export and own
records.description: Build, test and export independent Python automations. MIT-licensed runner, transparent decisions, no paid APIs, subscriptions or platform lock-in.

records.name: Thmenu
records.tagline: Get your restaurant's QR menu live today
records.description: Replace paper menus with QR codes, real-time ordering, 31 languages, and AI-powered content — all in one platform. Setup takes 2 minutes.

records.name: Muse Automation Blueprint
records.tagline: Automate daily PC busywork in 1 click without any code.
records.description: Stop wasting 120+ hours a year on tedious manual PC tasks. Muse Automation Blueprint is your practical, no-code guide to transforming repetitive daily routines into effortless 1-click desktop shortcuts and hotkeys. What's Inside: 4 real-world automation recipes (Auto-login, Excel-to-Web, File cleanup, Slack reporting) Task Audit Worksheet to pinpoint high-ROI automation targets Error-proofing flowcharts and dynamic wait strategies Step-by-step setup for global hotkeys & scheduled timers

records.name: Page Sheriff
records.tagline: Free landing page audit with a score and top fixes
records.description: Paste any public landing page URL and get a free conversion audit with no sign-up: a score out of 100, six sub-scores (clarity of offer, headline, call to action, trust and social proof, objection handling, SEO basics) and the top fixes to start with. Optional one-time PDF reports at $4.99, $7.99 and $9.99. No subscription. Built for founders, indie hackers, small teams and freelancers who want an outside check before spending more on traffic.

records.name: Sequence Tool
records.tagline: Edit with words: long recordings into polished stories
records.description: Sequence Tool is a native Mac app that turns long recordings into stories. Edit from text, prepare multiple angles, and export. It offers on-device transcription with optional CLI and MCP, designed to speed first-pass editing and surface key moments faster. Create what Matters.

records.name: FuseCanvas
records.tagline: Draw fuse bead patterns and export printable grids
records.description: Create fuse bead patterns in your browser, preview them in 2D and 3D, and count beads by color. Basic PNG, PDF and JSON exports are free. No account needed to start; optional Pro adds storage and advanced exports.

records.name: The Translation Workshop
records.tagline: Translate, edit, and refine your text with AI.
records.description: Real-time AI translation of novels, non-fiction and professional texts. Review and edit every paragraph yourself before downloading. 1,000 words free to try — your text is never used to train any model.

records.name: QR Tools: Scan & Generate
records.tagline: QR Code Scanner , QR Scanner: Barcode Scanner
records.description: QR Tools: Scan & Generate is a simple and powerful QR code and barcode utility for scanning, creating, managing, and sharing codes. Scan QR codes and barcodes quickly, create custom QR codes for different types of information, and keep your scanned codes organized with history and favorites. Key Features QR Tools: Scan & Generate is designed to keep QR scanning, QR creation, barcode generation, and saved code management together in one convenient app.

records.name: Hunchcheck
records.tagline: Get data-backed market research for your app idea
records.description: Hunchcheck delivers fast, data-backed market research so you can validate an app idea before building. It compiles competitors, prices, traffic, ads, and user complaints, and measures real search demand and trends. You also get curated customer quotes, contactable leads, communities to launch in, and a clear 7‑day test plan with a viability score. Hunchcheck links every claim to its source and offers pay‑per‑report access without creating an account.

records.name: Efibrain
records.tagline: AI chatbot for WhatsApp Business and websites
records.description: Efibrain is an AI assistant that answers your customers 24/7 on WhatsApp Business and on your website, and hands the conversation over to a human when needed. Built for SMBs and service businesses in Spain and Latin America. Unlimited users, no lock-in, plans from 30 €/month. Self-install or let the Efiprox team set it up for you.

records.name: MyAIRap.video
records.tagline: Make your photo rap with original AI video performances
records.description: Turn a photo and your idea into a short original Rap video. Choose Solo, Duo or Pet, edit the lyrics, and choose the scene, style and voice direction. Download your result. One-time credit packs, no subscription.

records.name: BoltWiki
records.tagline: Find the failing car part and prove it before you buy
records.description: Describe what your car is doing. BoltWiki asks the yes/no questions a mechanic would ask, then shows the likely part, whether it’s safe to drive, and the checks that prove it. Free, built on 12,600+ guides, with new guides and cases added every week.

records.name: RapidCreate
records.tagline: Type a hook, get up to five finished vertical videos
records.description: Type a hook, get up to five finished vertical videos for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, with script, footage, captions, music and your brand, in fifty styles. Make carousels and single posts in 42 templates, in your brand, built from your website or app link. A full video editor sits underneath to change anything it made: titles, transitions, keyframes, charts and word-by-word captions. Edits and exports run on your computer and never cost a credit. Your first five videos and first post are free.

records.name: coinbilka
records.tagline: Track Binance Spot trades as separate rotations
records.description: Track Binance Spot trades in isolated rotations. See each position’s buys, sells, fees, and realized P&L separately, alongside your wallet balances and portfolio history—without wallet-wide averages masking the result of an individual trade.

records.name: CamScanner Alternative Free ScanMint AI
records.tagline: it scans documents , generate pdf , QR Code Scanning & More
records.description: Millions of documents scan in one App, ScanMint Ai.

records.name: Gigapurge
records.tagline: The Mac cleaner that shows proof before deleting anything
records.description: Free up space on your Mac without the risk. Gigapurge shows why each file is safe to remove before anything moves. Everything goes to the Trash, and one click puts it back. Free scan, no account, no analytics.

records.name: ZKStamp Proof-100
records.tagline: Shielded proof-of-existence timestamps for AI agents.
records.description: Private, dated proofs of data on the BitcoinZ blockchain (zk-SNARKs). Stamp it with Z. Before Q.
